title: Shish Kebabs with Russian Sauce
description: A flavorful and spicy kebab recipe with a tangy Russian sauce made with smoked meat, wild mushrooms, and cucumbers.

ingredients.name: smoked meat (such as lamb or beef)

instructions: Thread mushrooms, meat, and cucumber onto skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together Russian spice blend, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Brush the spice mixture onto the skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the skewers are cooking, mix together chopped dill, garlic, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve the skewers hot with the Russian sauce spooned over the top.
